page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

In terms of network and storage configuration, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It features no integrated local SSD storage, requiring all persistent block storage to be provisioned via attached network storage volumes. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

From an infrastructure architectural standpoint, the allocation profile prioritizes high CPU core density relative to memory capacity. This design provides hardware-level compute efficiency for multi-threaded processing tasks without the additional cost overhead of large memory arrays or onboard storage. A notable tradeoff is the total reliance on remote network storage, which shifts storage throughput performance to network interfaces.

The ecs.c7a.32xlarge instance is suitable for compute-heavy workloads such as high-performance batch processing, parallel software compilation, scientific simulation, and distributed compute worker nodes where memory capacity demands do not exceed 2 GB per vCPU.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. This provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, optimizing compute density for CPU-bound operations. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 32 Gbps. The server includes no onboard local storage, necessitating external network-attached volumes for data persistence, and contains no dedicated GPU hardware. This hardware profile delivers qualitative cost efficiency by focusing resources on raw CPU throughput rather than expensive memory pools or integrated NVMe storage. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is well-suited for compute-intensive applications such as batch processing, large-scale software compilation, continuous integration build clusters, and parallel scientific modeling.
